title: Sam's weekend
subtitle: An interview for the school newsletter — question words
canDo: I can ask questions with what, where, when, who, how often and why.
I can answer why-questions with because.
I can write about my weekend.
teacherNotes: Ünitenin son dersi: "My weekend" yazısını ödev verin (Copy my text ile gönderilecek).
Soru sırası formülünü tahtada tutun: Soru kelimesi + do / does + kişi + fiil? (Where do you live?). be fiilinde do yok (Where are you from?).
Röportaj etkinliği: öğrenciler ikişerli olup birbirine 5 soru sorsun, sonra cevapları okuma metnindeki gibi he / she ile anlatsın.
Why / because: Türkçede "çünkü" cümle başında da olabilir; İngilizcede konuşmada Because… ile tek başına cevap vermek doğaldır.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Meet our neighbor: Sam Taylor
sections.intro: Elif's article in the school newsletter.
paragraphs: Sam Taylor is from London, but he lives in Boston now.
He opens his café at seven every weekday.
On Sundays, he sleeps late and walks on the beach with his dog, Biscuit.
He goes to London once a year, in the summer, and he always visits his mum.
“Because the people are friendly,” he says.
And who makes the famous cookies?
His wife, Emma! But that's a secret.

items.prompt: When does Sam go to London?
Who does he visit in London?

sections.title: Grammar: question words
look: **What time do** you open the café?
rules: Question word + **do / does** + person + verb: **Where do** you live?
With he / she: **does** — What **does** she like? (no -s on the verb)
With **be**: question word + am / is / are: **Where are** you from?
examples: What do you do in the evening?
Why do you study English? — Because I want a new job.

support.tr: Soru kelimesi (what, where, when…) başa gelir, sonra do / does, sonra kişi ve fiil: Where do you live? = Nerede yaşıyorsun? he / she ile does: Where does he live? Be fiilli sorularda do yok: Where are you from? Why (neden) sorusunun cevabı because (çünkü) ile başlar.
support.ar: تأتي أداة الاستفهام (what, where, when…) في البداية، ثم do / does، ثم الفاعل والفعل: Where do you live? = أين تسكن؟ ومع he / she نستخدم does: Where does he live? ومع فعل be لا نستخدم do: Where are you from? وجواب Why (لماذا) يبدأ عادةً بـ because (لأنّ).

tr.note: Soru kelimesinden sonra do / does'u unutma: soru kelimesi + do + kişi + fiil.
wrong: What time you open the café?
right: What time do you open the café?

ar.note: لا تترك السؤال بدون do / does، ولا تضع s على الفعل بعد does.

sections.title: Write: My weekend

model.heading: My weekend — Lucas
text: On Saturdays, I usually get up late.
In the afternoon, I play football with Omar.
On Saturday evenings, I sometimes play the guitar at Sam's café.
On Sundays, I always call my family in Brazil.
I love weekends because I can sleep late!
